purpose: Assess nominal-zero target equivalence with coefficient uncertainty and data-dependent target selection

method.primary: OLS joint coefficient ellipses: c=sqrt(2 F_(2,n-2)(1-alpha/18)); Working-Hotelling band; Bonferroni across 18 fits
method.coverage: At least 95% joint coverage conditional on correct linear mean and independent, normal, homoscedastic residuals within each fit; cross-fit independence is NOT required
method.equivalence: For every line in each ellipse, -T < (x*-b)/a < T. Positive slope verified on each ellipse. A conservative confidence-set equivalence assessment, not ordinary 90%-CI TOST
method.target_search: Intersect simultaneous admissible target sets, then select a midpoint for display; coverage event holds for all choices, so no unadjusted post-selection pointwise test
method.inverse: Invert (x*-b_hat-a_hat*q)^2 <= c^2*[1,q] V [1,q]^T; includes covariance between intercept and slope
method.sensitivity: Newey-West/Bartlett HAC covariance with lags=floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9)) and n/(n-2) scale; same F multiplier as primary. This is a sensitivity calculation without exact finite-sample 95% coverage
method.hac_order: Consecutive acquisition index within each run, not equal elapsed capture time; index-stationarity is an additional approximation
method.reference: Conditional on the saved center.bmp/template coordinate system; no new independent reference-image uncertainty experiment
method.scope: Mean-response nominal-zero agreement only; not future-image prediction, mixed-axis observability, or final control accuracy

assumption_status: Residual serial structure observed; primary exact-model coverage not established for these data. HAC is approximate with only 20 images per Y run. Report model-conditional/sensitivity results, not unconditional validation.

conclusion.interpretation: Primary model-conditional equivalence holds, but does not survive the HAC sensitivity calculation. Unconditional equivalence is not established; this does not prove actual non-equivalence.
